name: the-devbar-hint-follows-a-held-modifier
description: The floating address bar's back/forward/reload swap glyph and title for a held modifier, and the open hover hint must follow: the label switches to the variant's, and its key drops since none of the variants carry one. window.atriumSetNavModifiers is the receiver AtriumBrowserWindow::SetSidebarNavModifiers pushes from the native flagsChanged monitor - the devbar rarely holds the keyboard, so this is the realistic path, not a DOM keydown, and driving it directly avoids a real chord's flaky release. This run pushes that receiver and checks the hint's text and key before, during and after.

actions.note: ssh-launched Atrium is not frontmost on a clean snapshot
Developer Mode: brings up the floating address bar

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.dvnav .nb.sbback'); if (!b) { return 'no-button'; } b.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerover', {bubbles: true})); return 'hovered'; })()

actions.note: the same push AtriumBrowserWindow::SetSidebarNavModifiers sends from a real flagsChanged - no DOM key event at all

actions.expected: Back to the first page of this tab
actions.note: The pointer never moved - only the native push changed
Releasing restores the plain label and key, pointer still never moved

assertions.desc: the devbar came up with its nav group
the Back button was found and hovered
baseline: the plain hint before any modifier
baseline: the plain reload/back key sbback owns in FALLBACK_KEYS
the native-push receiver exists and ran

assertions.expected: Back to the first page of this tab
assertions.desc: The open hint followed the variant with no pointer movement
The option variant has no key of its own, so the plain key must not show
Releasing the modifier restored the plain label
Releasing the modifier restored the plain key
